# usage namer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageNamer`](gmeow-usageNamer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageNamer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent who uses the appellation for the named entity — the speaker/perspective holder. Non-functional: a usage may be shared by an audience of agents.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usageNamer`](gmeow-usageNamer.md) from [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md), [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record who actually uses the appellation — the speaker or perspective-holder behind a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating the namer with the audience it is used TOWARD ([`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md)) or the authority that sanctions it ([`gmeow:usageAuthority`](gmeow-usageAuthority.md)); these axes are orthogonal and must not be merged.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:usageNamer`](gmeow-usageNamer.md) agents to a [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) (non-functional — a shared usage has several); keep audience, authority, and namer as distinct properties.

- ex:usageFamily [`gmeow:usageNamer`](gmeow-usageNamer.md) ex:niece.
